## Why this is live now
The app doesn't keep its own copy of the design system. `server/main.js:58-62` and `:74` serve `/system/` directly from `prelude/prelude-design-system/system/`, and every page that uses the system loads `/system/components.css` (`server/views/_head.eta:16`). PR #53 is merged, so the app is already using the new menu CSS.

The new CSS (`prelude/prelude-design-system/system/components.css:264-298`) only places a `.menu-list` that has `[popover]`. That covers the anchoring, floating above panels and flipping to where there's room. The old `details.menu` rules are gone, and no other stylesheet in `server/public` or the shell's `layouts/` brings them back. A `<details class="menu">` still opens and closes, but its list should now appear in the normal page flow, pushing the toolbar and content around instead of floating. I haven't run the app to see this, so that's worth checking.

## What still uses `<details>`
The agent's count of 13 is wrong: there are **11** menus in `server/views/`:
- `_design-bar.eta`: 5 menus (lines 73, 90, 131 Capture, 160, 188)
- `_bar.eta:13` (projects), `_agents.eta:5` (running)
- `_chat.eta:19` (sessions), `_dictation.eta:36` (speech model, `.up`)
- `_page-menu.eta:9`, `_review-menu.eta:5`

The shell design has the same two as the app: `prelude/prelude-shell/layouts/_bar.eta` and `_agents.eta`.

Two pieces of script depend on `<details>` too, not just the one the warning names:
- `server/public/desktop.js:69-70` finds the menu with `closest('details')` and closes it with `menu.open = false`.
- Five `ko-set="….open = false"` close a menu when a row is used: `_bar.eta:17,22`, `_agents.eta:9`, `_design-bar.eta:139,144` and `_dictation.eta:40`. `.open` doesn't exist on a popover, so these do nothing once the menus move.

## What I'd change (on a branch)
- **The 11 views:** change `<details class="menu …">` to `<div class="menu …">`, and the `<summary class="btn …">` to `<button type="button" popovertarget ko-for="name">`. Put `ko-as="name" popover` on the `.menu-list`. This follows `system/components/menu.html` and Koda's `ko-for` (reference.md, "ko-for – the target by name"). Move each existing `ko-as` (`projects`, `running`, `captureMenu`, `modelMenu`) from the wrapper to the list. Capture's form already has `id="capture-form"`, so that's the one place an id could be used directly.
- **Closing on a row:** remove the `ko-set="x.open = false"` attributes. Links that go to a new page don't need them. Rows that submit in place are a different case. The design system's NOTES.md (line 135) points out that a menu stays open unless the response replaces it. For those, use Koda's `hide-popover` command (reference.md:1565), or let the region refresh replace the menu.
- **`desktop.js`:** find the menu with `button.closest('[popover]')` and close it with `?.hidePopover()`. The two-frame wait before the capture can stay.
- **Shell:** make the same change in `prelude/prelude-shell/layouts/_bar.eta` and `_agents.eta`, so the shell design stays in step with the app.
- **NOTES.md:** correct the "13" to 11 at line 132, and remove that open question once the views have moved.

1	# Prelude architecture
2	
3	Prelude is a tool for designing and then building an app with an agent: you pick a project, chat with the Claude Code CLI, and watch the design appear beside the chat. It runs as one Node server (plain `node:http`, views in Eta, Koda in the page) on localhost:4200, optionally inside a Tauri desktop window. Everything it produces is files in the project's `prelude/` folder, each design worked on in its own git branch and worktree. Agent-written views render in a sandboxed child process, and each design is served on its own preview origin.
4	
5	## Layers
6	
7	1. Windows
8	2. Entry points
9	3. Pages
10	4. Agent and live state
11	5. Designs and hosting
12	6. Project files
13	7. Shared helpers
14	8. Outside
15	
16	## Principles
17	
18	- **The folder is the database.** Everything Prelude makes is a file under the project's `prelude/`, committed with the code; `~/.prelude/` holds only machine-local conveniences, so nothing is lost if it's deleted.
19	- **The server is the single source of truth for live state.** Every window (chat, pop-out, browser tab) renders from the server and re-renders on its SSE events, so no window holds state another needs.
20	- **Agent-written code never runs in the server's process.** A design's views render in a sandboxed renderer, and a host that runs them unsandboxed starts only once the person approves it.
21	- **The agent works with ordinary file tools, fenced to what it may touch.** It reads the project and the folders added as references, writes only where its mode allows, and deletes by writing a file empty.
22	- **A design's memory is its files, not a conversation.** Each session starts from NOTES.md, the views and states, so sessions on different machines and branches pick up where the work stands.
23	- **Committed files must merge cleanly.** Session folders and decision ids are random, transcripts are append-only, and there's no shared index that every session rewrites.

1454	<select id="method" ko-set="rate.value = self.option.attr('data-rate')">
1455	  <option value="appraisal" data-rate="0.80">Appraisal</option>
1456	</select>
1457	
1458	<button type="button" ko-set="owner.value = owner.original; ownerBox.hidden = true">
1459	  Undo
1460	</button>
1461	```
1462	
1463	Each action is `<place> = <expression>`. The left-hand side is an ordinary
1464	expression ending in a property, so anything that names an element works there —
1465	including `ref('line-1-qty').value` for an id that is not a legal identifier.
1466	The property names the same targets `calc-*` writes to, and means the same
1467	thing. Several actions are separated by `;` and run in order, so a later one
1468	sees what an earlier one wrote.
1469	
1470	An attribute whose name contains a hyphen is written as a string, because a
1471	hyphen is a subtraction everywhere else an expression can appear:
1472	
1473	```html
1474	<button ko-set="panel['data-state'] = 'open'">      <!-- not panel.data-state -->
1475	```
1476	
1477	The subscript must be a literal. The target is decided when the action is read
1478	rather than each time it runs, which is what lets an impossible one be reported
1479	at all rather than writing to an attribute called `undefined`.

1	# Prelude Shell - notes
2	
3	Prelude's own app shell: the layouts Prelude's pages render in. Drafted from
4	what Prelude ships (`server/views/layout.eta`, the `.bar`/`.page`/`.workspace`
5	rules in `server/public/prelude.css`, and the pop-out `_window.eta`), on the
6	Prelude Design System. Gallery: `/gallery` (with `/drawer`, `/modal`,
7	`/notice` over it), `/gallery/workspace`, `/gallery/window`.
8	
9	## Layouts
10	
11	- **app** - the bar, then the page scrolling with the window. Pages hold their
12	  own width (`.center`); the shell gives the room above and below. Projects, a
13	  project, Build.
14	- ~~**workspace**~~ - retired 2026-10-18 (see "One layout for the app's pages"
15	  below). A design's page (chat + surface) is in the app layout and fills the
16	  window by marking itself `.fills`.
17	- **window** - no bar; the page fills the window. The pop-out design surface.
18	
19	Shared parts in `layouts/` (`_head`, `_bar`, `_agents`, `_regions`), since a layout's
20	includes resolve from there. Chrome CSS is `layouts/shell.css`, all in the
21	`host` layer, styling only `.shell-*`. `styles.css` is the gallery's alone.
22	
23	## Decisions
24	
25	- **The gallery shows placeholders, not content** (Prelude's guidance,
26	  2026-10-16): grey `.skeleton` blocks (styles.css) wherever a page or an
27	  overlay puts content, so what's real on screen is the layout's. The only
28	  real content is the buttons that open each region. Placeholder headings keep
29	  a hidden name ("Sample drawer", "Sample question"), so the dialog is still
30	  named and the Close still lines up. States hold only layout data now.
31	- **"Project", not "folder"** (the person's decision, 2026-10-16), in every
32	  word the shell shows and in its data (`it.layout.projects`, `agents[].project`).
33	  URLs keep `/f/<id>`: they're the app's routes, not words. A folder the agent
34	  may read (not the project) is still a folder. The design system's
35	  guidelines.md still says "folder, not project

The app's menus now use the design system's popover. I couldn't run the tests or the app here, so none of it is verified yet.

**Cause:** the app doesn't keep its own copy of the design system. It serves `/system/` straight from `prelude/prelude-design-system/system/`, so the new menu CSS reached the app as soon as the system's change was merged. That CSS only positions a popover list, so the app's `<details>` menus should now open in the normal page flow, pushing the bar and panel around. There were 11 of them, not 13.

**What changed:**
- **All 11 menus** follow the system's markup: a button with `popovertarget ko-for="…"` and the list with `ko-as="…" popover`. That's the five in the design bar, plus the page, review, sessions, speech model, Projects and agents menus. The two review menus can be on the page at once, so each opens its own list.
- **Closing when a row is used:** a popover closes on a click outside or Escape, but not when you press one of its rows. In Prelude a row never takes you to a new page, so a menu would otherwise stay open. A small listener in `_regions.eta` closes the menu when a row is pressed. It replaces the five `ko-set="….open = false"`, which don't work on a popover. The "Use this size" button doesn't count as a row, so typing a custom size doesn't close the menu.
- **`desktop.js`:** "What's in view" now closes its menu with `hidePopover()`. It has to do this itself because it stops the click before the listener sees it.
- **Shell design:** `_bar`, `_agents` and `_regions` got the same change. Its open question about bar menus not closing on an outside click is now answered, so I removed it.
- **Notes:** Design Workspace, Build, Prelude Shell and the design system each have a line on what changed and why. The fix's NOTES.md has the full write-up.
- **Tests:** I updated the two assertions that matched the old markup (`test/events.test.js`, `test/host.test.js`). I added `test/menus.test.js`, which checks that no view or shell layout still has a `<details>` menu or an `.open = false`, and that every menu list is a named popover with a button that opens it.

I didn't need to propose any architecture changes: the views stay in the views part and `desktop.js` stays in the desktop part.

**One behaviour change to look at:** "Send event" used to stay open after you sent an event, and now it closes like every other menu. Capture's "The whole page" also closes now in the browser, where before it closed through its `ko-set`.

**To check:**
- Run `npm test`, or just `node --test test/menus.test.js test/events.test.js test/host.test.js`.
- Open each menu and check that it floats over the frame and closes on an outside click, on Escape, and when you press a row.
- The speech model menu opens upwards.
- In the desktop app, the Capture menu isn't in the picture.
- Pages showing these menus will differ from their approved screens on purpose. Approve them again if they look right.
